response.sql: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(powerstatus, 'Missing') as powerstatus, COUNT(*) as telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY COALESCE(powerstatus, 'Missing')), total_telescopes AS (SELECT SUM(telescope_count) as total FROM status_counts), status_shares AS (SELECT sc.powerstatus, sc.telescope_count, (sc.telescope_count * 100.0 / tt.total) as share_pct FROM status_counts sc CROSS JOIN total_telescopes tt), avg_share_calc AS (SELECT AVG(share_pct) as avg_pct FROM status_shares), above_average AS (SELECT ss.telescope_count, ss.share_pct, (ss.share_pct - asc.avg_pct) as excess FROM status_shares ss CROSS JOIN avg_share_calc asc WHERE ss.share_pct > asc.avg_pct) SELECT SUM(telescope_count) as total_telescopes, AVG(share_pct) as avg_share, AVG(excess) as avg_excess_above_average FROM above_average
